name: poly-record
description: Layer: wire held-note capture into the record path. Replaces the armed single-note store at 0x08025814 (2-byte strb + 2-byte b) with a b.w to a cave that (1) DOES the original store verbatim, then (2) merges the note into a per-(track,step) poly array in CCM at 0x1000B530. Additive: original playback data is untouched. Layout per step: byte0=count(<=8), entries [note,vel] at +1+2*i (stride 17). Per-track stride 128*17=0x880; 3 melodic tracks. poly_merge clips a stale count>8 to 0 (no boot-init needed).
